This application continuously records audio from your device's microphone while active.

 RECORDING OTHER PEOPLE WITHOUT THEIR EXPLICIT CONSENT MAY BE ILLEGAL IN YOUR JURISDICTION.

 Many countries and regions have strict laws regarding audio recording, including but not limited to:

 • Two-party (or all-party) consent laws that require every person being recorded to give explicit permission
 • Privacy laws such as GDPR (EU), CCPA (California), and similar regulations worldwide
 • Wiretapping and eavesdropping statutes

 By using this application, you acknowledge and agree that:

 1. YOU are solely and entirely responsible for ensuring that your use of this application complies with all applicable local, regional, national, and international laws and regulations.

 2. YOU must obtain proper consent from all individuals who may be recorded before activating the recording feature.

 3. The developer of this application assumes ZERO liability for any legal consequences, damages, claims, or penalties arising from your use or misuse of this application.

 4. The developer does NOT encourage or endorse the recording of any person without their knowledge and explicit consent.

 5. This application may record voices, conversations, and sounds of people around you. It is YOUR responsibility to inform them and obtain their consent.

 If you do not understand or do not agree to these terms, do not use this application.
I understand and accept full responsibility
Recording others without consent may be illegal
Recordings are not uploaded to the cloud
Segments are uploaded automatically when connected to Wi-Fi. Uses ~345 MB/day. Recommended for most users.
Segments are uploaded over any connection including mobile data. Uses ~345 MB/day of data. May incur significant mobile data charges.
Connect a Google Drive account to enable cloud uploads.
Google Drive is out of space. Uploads are paused until you free some.
Could not connect to Google Drive. Please try again.

Google signed in with a different account than the one your recordings are backed up to. To avoid uploading them to the wrong Drive, nothing has been uploaded. Disconnect and reconnect, choosing the original account.
Free users can only save recordings from the last 15 minutes. Upgrade to Premium to access the full 24-hour buffer.
Cloud storage is a premium feature. Upgrade to automatically back up your recordings to Google Drive for safekeeping.
Older recordings have been moved to a recovery folder on Google Drive. Open Back Recorder for details.
Recovered recordings are available in your Google Drive under BackRecorder/recovery_%1$s. Please move them to a safe location — they will not be automatically deleted.
